newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil rebounds at close, seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil rebounds at close, seen consolidating.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES -The market rebounded slightly at the close on soyoil gains after Tuesday's fall. Trading was cautious as the undertone remained bearish due to poor fundamentals. Sept futures drifted in a tight range. Sept will trade between 1,120 and 1,150 in near-term.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Some interest was seen among products. The market awaits the performance of soyoil futures in Chicago.
Traders added that rising output due to the approaching high harvest period and increasing stocks could limit gains.
Technically, the market should consolidate at around current levels, they said, adding that September futures contract is likey to trade between 1,120 and 1,150 ringgit in the near-term.
At the close, the September contract rose three ringgit at 1,137 ringgit ($454.25) a tonne.
Physicals saw July (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,180 ringgit against bids at 1,175 after trading at 1,180 and 1,177.50.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $532.50, Aug/Sept at $530, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $527.50. Aug/Sept was traded at $527.50 and and Oct/Nov/Dec at $527.50.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $382.50 and July/Aug palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
